history.content: Hi, my phone has no service at all—no bars, nothing loads, and I can't send a picture message. Can you help?

I'm sorry to hear you're experiencing no service on your phone. Let's try to resolve this together. To assist you better, could you please provide your phone number or the name on your account? This will help me check your line status and see if there are any issues affecting your service.

Your phone line is currently suspended, which is why you have no service and cannot send messages or use data.

Would you like me to resume your line so you can regain service? If you know the reason for the suspension or if it was a mistake, please let me know so I can assist you further.
I wasn't aware my line was suspended. Yes, please resume my line so I can get service back.

It appears your line cannot be resumed because the contract end date (November 30, 2024) has already passed. This means your service contract has expired, which is likely why your line was suspended.

To restore your service, you may need to renew your contract or select a new plan. Would you like information on renewing your contract or choosing a new plan? I can guide you through the next steps.
